Findings.Comment: The new rule is meant to hide the remember-me block, but `.login-form > div:last-child` resolves to the `.actions` div (the last child of the form), not `.remember`. On every login form render the `display: none` therefore lands on the wrapper containing the `Sign in` button, so the form has no visible submit control, while the `Keep me signed in` checkbox — the thing the comment says is hidden — stays on screen. The updated e2e snapshot already shows exactly this: the button is gone, the checkbox is still there.
